description: SAY WHAT THE BRIDGE COULD NOT DO, IN ONE SENTENCE — and it becomes a line in a file the human reads (~/.qiksy/gaps.jsonl). This is the sanctioned way out of a dead end, and it exists because the usual way out is worse: an agent that hits a wall silently switches to another browser driver, and the run stops being the test that was asked for. Use it when the bridge genuinely lacks a capability — not when a control refused once (that is the ladder in the instructions: qa_probe, raw, a CSS selector, qa_click by name). op:"list" reads the log back, newest first, which is also how you check whether your gap is already known.

blocked.description: True when this stopped the task outright, rather than merely costing extra calls

op.description: "add" records a gap; "list" reads them back

tried.description: What you already tried — the rungs of the ladder you climbed, so nobody re-suggests them

url.description: The page it happened on (the query string is stripped before it is written)

verb.description: The verb you were using when you hit it, e.g. "qa_read"

wanted.description: What you needed the bridge to do, in one sentence. Required for "add".

name: qa_gap
title: Record what the bridge could not do
